g.text: The mathematics and the debt

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: Companion to strips 01–08 · supplied structure, derived consequences, explicit limits

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: What these pictures can establish
This is a supplied classical model with one degree of freedom. It makes a local Hamiltonian construction and one
Noether example visible. It does not derive mechanics from marks alone, nor yet explain quantum mechanics.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: 01–04 · Comparing, composing, refining, returning
We supply an oriented affine plane and comparison by translation. Tip-to-tail composition is vector addition in
that plane. Refinement samples a prescribed differentiable path; finite drawings do not prove a limit or
smoothness. A supplied reversible rotation gives cyclic relative position. That is geometric phase, not a quantum
amplitude. Colours distinguish marks; they do not specify a physical ontology.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: 05 · The extra structure that makes Hamilton possible
For the remaining strips we choose a state plane with dimensionless conjugate coordinates q,p and oriented area ω
= dq ∧ dp. This pairing is an assumption: perpendicular ink strokes do not establish it. With physical units, p dq
has units of action; momentum need not equal velocity. The patch is the object being transformed, not a background
container. Its orientation matters.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: 05 → 06 · The local derivation
Assume an autonomous C¹ field X=(u,v), its differentiable local flow, and preservation of ω for EVERY sufficiently
small cell. One sheared patch only illustrates this hypothesis. Area preservation gives u_q + v_p = 0. Hence α =
ι_Xω = u dp − v dq is closed: dα = 0. On a simply connected local patch α=dH, so
The Hamiltonian is reconstructed up to an additive constant. This is local: topology may obstruct a globally
single-valued H. Calling H physical energy requires a physical model.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: 06 · An exact turning rule
Choose H=(q²+p²)/2. Then q̇=p and ṗ=−q. The orange arrows depict instantaneous changes, not consecutive finite
kicks. For a time h the exact update is
q′ = q cos h + p sin h, p′ = p cos h − q sin h.
It preserves both oriented area and H. The naive Euler update (q+h p, p−h q) instead multiplies area and q²+p² by
1+h². Cyclic motion belongs to this example, not to every Hamiltonian flow.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: 07 · A different rule and its continuous symmetry
Now choose H=p²/2. The exact evolution is Φ_t(q,p)=(q+t p,p). Shifting the starting configuration by
T_a(q,p)=(q+a,p) commutes with that evolution: Φ_t T_a=T_a Φ_t. This canonical translation leaves H unchanged.
Strip 7 switches rules; the oscillator of strip 6 does NOT have this translation symmetry.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: 08 · The Noether charge and why it is conserved
The translation generator Y=∂q obeys ι_Yω=dp, so its charge is J=p. Hamilton’s equations give dJ/dt=ṗ=−H_q=0. In
variational language, S=∫(p q̇−H)dt is invariant under constant q translations; stationarity supplies the
equations and conserved momentum. The symmetry, action structure and equations jointly justify conservation. A
repeated equal mark or unchanged gap alone does not prove Noether’s theorem.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f78

g.text: Limits and the remaining debt
Supplied: affine structure, oriented pairing, regularity, model choice and variational hypotheses. Derived under
those assumptions: local Hamiltonian form; two exact example flows; the translation charge and its conservation.
Not established: the earlier Genesis/L1 derivation, any identity between holonomy and Noether, Born probabilities,
Everett branching, Bell correlations, or an ontology of the universe. Those require further constructions and
evidence.
